priority_items.title: PACNEWS/SPREP close-out names Siu-i-Alaimoana Ki Likutapu; Fakafanua Chair; official PDF still missing
priority_items.summary: In-window PACNEWS ONE 17 Sep reprints SPREP Nuku'alofa dateline: PMMM-4 concluded Wednesday with the Siu-i-Alaimoana Ki Likutapu Declaration; Tonga PM Lord Fatafehi Fakafanua named PMMM-4 Chair and Weather Ready Champion. Working-title Matatoa not used. pacificmet.net still programme-plus-draft and future tense; adopted PDF unpublished ~18h51 after reception close; SPREP origin Cloudflare 403. Political ministerial text, not a security pact. Not FLASH.
